sources.label: Clean, ad-free Morphe patches for popular Android apps.
sources.author: GinArena
patch_list: Makes Google sign-in work on a re-signed WPS by signing in as the original app. Needs MicroG RE installed with a Google account added. WPS account login is unaffected.

Opens the paid tools - PDF, export, editing, fonts and templates - by answering the app's payment checks. Every part has its own switch, so you choose what is unlocked. Sign in first: signed out, WPS reports no membership at all.

sources.label: Morphe Patches for SoundCloud
sources.author: Hoodles
patch_list: Disables various anti-tamper checks that causes the app to force-close.
Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall. Login is required and AI functionality is unavailable.
